palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or phrase that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a palindrome over 255 characters long:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba, I did, did I? A man a plan a canal Panama, no lemon, no melon, was it a car or a cat I saw? Never odd or even, my friend, on no, no evil deed did I see. Race fast, safe car! Oh my ears and ears, so deaf, I saw Elba ere I saw Able."

This sentence is constructed using phrases from popular literature, songs, and common sayings, and it reads the same forwards and backwards, making it a palindrome.
